description.value: The Sunshine Inn Hotel is one of four properties in a small Northern BC chain strung along the Highway 16 corridor between Prince George and Prince Rupert — a common long-distance cycling route. The Smithers location sits in downtown Smithers at the foot of Hudson Bay Mountain, making it a convenient base for the Bulkley Valley. Continental breakfast is included, parking accommodates vehicles of all sizes including RVs and trailers, and 24-hour front desk service is available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Smithers location at 3880 4th Ave with phone 250-847-6668 matching OSM. Chain-wide pages confirm free Wi-Fi, free parking (including RVs/trailers), continental breakfast at Smithers, 24-hour reception, and luggage storage. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash anywhere on the site; the vending machine mention is Houston-location-specific only. The COVID food-suspension note in the FAQ appears legacy content, as the main and about pages consistently list continental breakfast as included at Smithers.
concerns: Smithers-specific amenities subpage (/locations/smithers/amenities-faq/) was not captured in the fetched content; some amenity details are inferred from chain-wide pages rather than Smithers-specific content.
The FAQ breakfast note references COVID suspension, which appears to be legacy/outdated content — main pages consistently list continental breakfast as included at Smithers.
No evidence of bike-specific infrastructure or staff training for cycling guests anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate, active accommodation on a major touring corridor (Hwy 16), but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedures are mentioned anywhere on the website, and these are the two required WWC criteria. A direct inquiry to the property is needed before a confident 'include' verdict.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number for Smithers location is 1-877-674-4637 per website, not present in OSM. Website is a multi-location chain site; Smithers is one of four properties.

Luggage storage.detail: FAQ states: 'Yes, we can look after your luggage free of charge. If you arrive early or are not ready to take your bags after checking out, we will store your goods for the day.'
